gr.title: Attica Roots Festival: Η Ευανθία Ρεμπούτσικα πλημμύρισε με τις μελωδίες της τον κήπο του Εθνικού Αρχαιολογικού Μουσείου -Μια μαγική βραδιά
gr.description: Μια μαγική, φωτεινή και βαθιά συγκινητική βραδιά εκτυλίχθηκε κάτω από τον ανοιχτό ουρανό της Αθήνας, στον κήπο του Εθνικού Αρχαιολογικού Μουσείου, το βράδυ της Παρασκευής, με δωρεάν είσοδο για όλους χάρη στο Attica Roots Festival, τον μεγάλο πολιτιστικό θεσμό της Περιφέρειας Αττικής, που ξεκίνησε φέτος για πρώτη χρονιά και συνεχίζει τις καλοκαιρινές του στάσεις σε ιστορικά τοπόσημα. Η Ευανθία Ρεμπούτσικα παρέσυρε το κοινό σε ένα ανεπανάληπτο μουσικό ταξίδι, αποδεικνύοντας πώς η μουσική κληρονομιά μπορεί να δεθεί αρμονικά με τη σύγχρονη δημιουργία. Η σπουδαία συνθέτις με το βιολί της μας ταξίδεψε σε σταυροδρόμια της Ανατολικής Μεσογείου γεμάτα συγκινητικές μνήμες, ολοζώντανες εικόνες και πρωτόγνωρα συναισθήματα. Από τα πρώτα κιόλας λεπτά της συναυλίας η ατμόσφαιρα γέμισε με μια μοναδική ενέργεια. Το κοινό έπαψε γρήγορα να είναι ένας απλός θεατής και μεταμορφώθηκε σε έναν ενθουσιώδη συνοδοιπόρο σε αυτή την ονειρική διαδρομή. Η έναρξη με το ξεσηκωτικό «The wedding dance» έδωσε αμέσως τον ρυθμό, πλημμυρίζοντας τον ιστορικό χώρο με ζωντάνια και μια γιορτινή διάθεση που ένωσε όλους τους παρευρισκόμενους. Η συγκίνηση, όμως, κορυφώθηκε όταν στη σκηνή ανέβηκε η εξαιρετική Σοφία Ζώβα. Η ερμηνεία της στην «Πρωινή προσευχή» λειτούργησε σαν ένας μυστικός διάλογος με το κοινό, προσφέροντας μια στιγμή απόλυτης κατάνυξης μέσα στη ζεστή καλοκαιρινή νύχτα. Και λίγο αργότερα, το γεμάτο ένταση «Εξοδος 1922» έφερε στο προσκήνιο την ιστορική μνήμη και τη νοσταλγία, προκαλώντας ρίγη συγκίνησης. Η Ευανθία Ρεμπούτσικα, με το αστείρευτο πάθος της, μας καθοδήγησε σε τόπους γνώριμους,αλλά και απροσδόκητους. Οταν ακούστηκαν οι πρώτες νότες από το «Αρωμα κανέλας», με τις μυρωδιές και τα χρώματα της Πόλης, ξύπνησανγλυκές αναμνήσεις περασμένων εποχών, αφηγήσεων, ιστοριών και Ιστορίας. Η περιπλάνηση συνεχίστηκε με το κομμάτι «Αλεξάνδρεια», όπου η φωνή της Σοφίας Ζώβα μάς μετέφερε στις όχθες του Νείλου, δημιουργώντας ένα κινηματογραφικό σκηνικό κάτω από τα αστέρια. Ιδιαίτερη θέση στη μυσταγωγία της βραδιάς είχαν και οι εμβληματικές κινηματογραφικές μελωδίες της δημιουργού, οι οποίες πλημμύρισαν τις ψυχές μας με εικόνες, χρώματα και συναισθήματα. Η μουσική της, άρρηκτα συνδεδεμένη με τη μεγάλη οθόνη, λειτούργησε ως ένας εσωτερικός προβολέας αναμνήσεων. Κάθε νότα ήταν σαν να συνόδευε νοερά ένα κινηματογραφικό καρέ, μετατρέποντας τον κήπο του μουσείου σε ένα απέραντο σινεμά των αισθήσεων. Οι μελωδίες αυτές άγγιξαν τις πιο ευαίσθητες χορδές των θεατών, αποδεικνύοντας ότι η Ευ. Ρεμπούτσικα είναι εξαιρετική στο να συνθέτει έναμοναδικό συναυλιακό ταξίδι, όπου το βίωμα γίνεται Τέχνη και το όνειρο πραγματικότητα. Προς το κλείσιμο του προγράμματος, το «Βαλς του δρόμου» ξεσήκωσε το κοινό, παρασύροντάς το σε έναν συλλογικό, μελωδικό χορό. Το οδοιπορικό αυτό ολοκληρώθηκε ιδανικά με το «Carousel», μια σύνθεση που έμοιαζε να εμπεριέχει τις παιδικές μας αναμνήσεις, τηλησμονημένη αθωότητα και την ελπίδα για το μέλλον. Αυτή η συναυλία δεν ήταν απλώς μια μουσική παράσταση, αλλά μια ολόφωτη εμπειρία, που θα μείνει χαραγμένη για καιρό μέσα μας. Η Ευανθία Ρεμπούτσικα μας κάλεσε να αφεθούμε, να θυμηθούμε, να ονειρευτούμε και να νιώσουμε μαζί. Σε αυτή την πρόσκληση, το κοινό απάντησε με παρατεταμένα χειροκροτήματα, γεμάτο ευγνωμοσύνη για μια νύχτα στην οποία το καλοκαίρι ταυτίστηκε με τις μελωδίες της και η μουσική έγινε η πατρίδα όλων μας. co.description: Authored by ruby.escamilla Image La Opinión Viernes, 10 de Julio de 2026 El compositor y productor colombiano Bobby Sierra vuelve a demostrar por qué es uno de los nombres más influyentes de la música latina con el lanzamiento de Lo Revivimos , el más reciente sencillo de Juanda Caribe, que en pocos días se ha convertido en uno de los temas de mayor crecimiento en las plataformas digitales. Desde su estreno, la canción ha conquistado al público y alcanzó e l Top 3 de YouTube Music Colombia , además de ingresar en las tendencias digitales de países como Panamá y Ecuador , consolidándose como uno de los lanzamientos más destacados de la región. Detrás de este éxito está la experiencia creativa de Bobby, quien ha construido una sólida trayectoria como compositor y productor. En Lo Revivimos , el artista apuesta por una propuesta romántica y contemporánea que aborda las segundas oportunidades en el amor, una temática que ha generado una amplia conversación entre los usuarios de redes sociales y plataformas de música. Le puede interesar: El Festival de Venecia reconoce a George Clooney con el León de Oro La carrera de Sierra está respaldada por importantes logros internacionales. Su catálogo acumula más de 2.000 millones de reproducciones en plataformas digitales, suma más de 40 discos de oro, un Latin Grammy, dos Premios ASCAP y tres canciones que alcanzaron el primer lugar del Billboard Latino, cifras que reflejan su impacto en la industria musical. Con Lo Revivimos, Bobby Sierra y Juanda Caribe unen talento , identidad caribeña y sensibilidad artística en una producción con gran proyección comercial. El sencillo ya está disponible en todas las plataformas digitales, donde continúa ampliando su alcance y reafirmando la apuesta de ambos artistas por crear música capaz de conectar con las emociones del público y trascender fronteras. in.title: CNN’s African Voices meets the Queen Consort of the Warri Kingdom
in.source: Brand Icon Image - Latest Brand, Tech And Business
in.description: African Voices airs on CNN International Saturday 11th July 2026 at 07:30 WAT. In the latest episode of CNN’s African Voices , Larry Madowo sits down with Her Majesty Olori Atuwatse III , Queen Consort of the Warri Kingdom . Her influence redefines modern royalty by championing education, empowering women, and inspiring the next generation. Her Majesty tells Madowo about her experience becoming Queen Consort and the responsibilities that come with the role, “I've always lived my life with purpose, and I think purpose isn't something to be chased, it's something to be stewarded, a responsibility to use this platform of privilege, as I call it, to serve to the betterment of the people that I've been called to.” Since becoming Queen Consort, Her Majesty has built the Royal Iwere Foundation to focus on education, empowerment, and the environment. She highlights the importance of Nigeria’s industrial scale while emphasising the importance of community, “I believe that our biggest resource is our human resource and my vision, my hope is to build our people so that they can build our communities. [...]. So, when I became Queen Consort, the first thing or the first responsibility that I felt to have was, let us build people that will build the community. So, every initiative that we run through the foundation is focused on re-engineering mindsets, giving access to greater opportunities, allowing the people to know that they have agency in forming the kind of future that they hope for and they look for.” The Queen Consort has faced many struggles in her life. She reminisces on how, in 2018, “I had just had my son, and I suffered from postpartum anxiety. And there was a night that I thought that I was literally going to die. I thought I was going to go crazy. And that moment I had an epiphany. It was like something came to me, it was like, if you died right now and you go and meet your Maker, what are you going to show for it? And at that moment I realised that I was gonna stop living for everybody else but myself.” While discussing her achievements, the Queen Consort tells Madowo that she recognises the systemic barriers still in place and the work that is needed to be done, “The majority of the continent is still very much rural, and what that would mean would be the belief systems are still very much ancient [...] There are also the internal barriers that nobody really speaks about as a woman [...]. And I think the work that I do with women in Nigeria and even across the continent is to first shift the internal biases, help them understand the power that lies within them, unlock that space of agency that they have within them, let them know that your mind works, your voice is powerful, you are the author of your own destiny. A woman that has that, a woman that is unlocked in that space, the external barriers, they'll fly open.” Her Majesty talks about her reign so far and what the future might hold, “ I feel like it's 5 years that's felt like 50. [...] It’s been challenging, most certainly it's been stretching, but it's also felt very fulfilling. [...] We can't delegate responsibility to anybody else. We must build a country, a nation, a continent that our children will be proud to inherit because they deserve it. sg.title: The Best Photo Shows at Les Rencontres d’Arles 2026
sg.description: The photography world has touched down in the South of France for Les Rencontres d’Arles. Known as the best of its kind, the international photography festival makes the ancient city its exhibition space: everywhere from churches and crypts, municipal buildings and historical landmarks, even the local Monoprix, becomes a stunning, albeit unlikely home for some of the world’s most compelling images.The beloved event is back for its 57th edition with a rich refresh of perspectives and styles from its emerging to established range. Attention to complexity and nuance sets the stage for this year’s iteration, which aims to “not to artificially soften the violence of reality, but to bring out its depth,” Les Rencontres d’Arles wrote. “To face a sometimes unsettling world while continuing to find beauty, connection and freedom in it.”Among the biggest draws of 2026 is filmmaker and photographer Park Chan-wook, whose On a Calm Morning at Lee Ufan Arles gallery shows a more introspective side to, as Soy Kim calls, "The Master of Dark Irony." William Klein, one of the post-war greats, gets a centenary spotlight with This Way to Heaven at the Museon Arlaten, which centers on his lesser-known political bodies of work.American photographer Ming Smith comes into focus at Eglise Sainte-Anne with her decade-spanning Wandering Light. From pools of pink flamingos to the inimitable Sun Ra, her spectral, softly rendered visions of Europe take on the warm haze of memories rather than records, and chart her own rise. Elsewhere, Harry Gruyaert offers his take on a chronicle of urban life through brilliant hues in the aptly titled Sense of Place at Chapelle Saint-Martin Du Mejan.In Photoromance, the festival is also revisiting the work of Ivorian photographer Paul Kodjo, whose cinematic portraits of 1970s Abidjan capture the city’s nightlife, fashion, and youth culture during Côte d’Ivoire’s post-independence boom.But beyond its heavy-hitters, as always, Les Rencontres d’Arles is putting us on to new names to know. French-Cameroonian artist Charlotte Yonga is a standout in the Discovery Award Louis Roederer Foundation exhibition with (Tsy) Possible, her ongoing series exploring love, intimacy and belonging in Madagascar. Aman Alam is also turning heads. Hailing from Bengaluru, the artist presents his deeply personal, ongoing Ozymandias series, a tender meditation on his grandmother’s Alzheimer’s diagnosis and the quiet grief that follows.If there’s one group show not to miss, it’s Come Together at the Fondation Manuel Rivera-Ortiz. Bringing together projects by Eric Bouvet, Regula Tschumi, Yuan Goang-Ming, Oleñka Carrasco & La Chica, and Shelby Duncan, the exhibition confronts the festival’s overarching ideas of connection and fragmentation head on through stunning captures that explore migration, political conflict, and ecological crises.If photography is your thing, there’s no better place to summer. Beyond the exhibitions, Les Rencontres d’Arles offers a packed calendar of artist talks, performances, and screenings, alongside the annual Arles Book Fair throughout the month. id.title: Debut Couture Minimalis Piccioli di Balenciaga & Chanel Resmi Akuisisi Pembuat Kemeja Tertua Prancis: Rangkuman Kabar Fashion Terpanas Pekan Ini
id.description: RingkasanParis menjadi saksi pergeseran besar di runway lewat debut Balenciaga serba minimal ala Piccioli, eksplorasi material avant-garde Schiaparelli dari Roseberry, dan koleksi Chanel bernuansa dongeng karya Blazy.Chanel mengakuisisi pembuat kemeja bersejarah Charvet, mengisyaratkan potensi ekspansi serius ke lini menswear.Nike Atelier menggandeng Désiré Doué dari PSG untuk sneakers edisi spesial.Balenciaga, Tapi Lebih Besar: Debut Couture Fall 2026 Pierpaolo PiccioliPierpaolo Piccioli resmi mengambil alih sorotan lewat koleksi Haute Couture perdananya untuk Balenciaga, menukar teatralitas dramatis pendahulunya dengan presentasi luar ruang yang lebih halus dan terkurasi. Berlatar tenang Cité Internationale Universitaire de Paris, runway kali ini sepenuhnya menyorot konstruksi busana yang presisi. Piccioli mengusung filosofi minimalis untuk menghasilkan siluet dramatis dan penuh volume lewat satu-dua gestur tegas. Sorotan utama antara lain trench berselimut bulu penuh yang dengan cerdik menyembunyikan celana teal, serta gaun violet monolitik yang mengembang hidup tertiup angin. Meski dihiasi sentuhan eksentrik—seperti surai bulu hitam raksasa yang dikenakan Gigi Hadid—koleksi ini tetap memprioritaskan gerak kain, membuktikan bahwa pendekatan minimalis tetap bisa menghadirkan impact visual yang luar biasa besar.Chanel Kini Memiliki Pembuat Kemeja Tertua di Prancis: CharvetBeberapa hari sebelum presentasi couture Fall 2026, Chanel mengumumkan akuisisi atas Charvet, pembuat kemeja legendaris Paris berusia 188 tahun. Kedua rumah bersejarah ini sebelumnya sudah berkolaborasi ketika direktur kreatif Chanel, Matthieu Blazy, menggandeng Charvet untuk kemeja bespoke di koleksi debut SS26-nya. Langkah strategis ini hadir seiring daftar duta pria Chanel yang kian panjang—termasuk A$AP Rocky dan Jacob Elordi—serta laporan peningkatan klien pria. Meski Charvet juga mencatat pertumbuhan signifikan pelanggan perempuan, akuisisi ini kian menyulut spekulasi industri bahwa Chanel tengah menyiapkan fondasi serius bagi divisi menswear khusus.Schiaparelli FW27 Haute Couture Menerobos Pakem Lama Lewat "THE CALL OF THE VOID"Creative Director Daniel Roseberry menelusuri wilayah tak terpetakan untuk presentasi Haute Couture Fall/Winter 2027 Schiaparelli, mengimajinasikan ulang tekstil mewah tradisional dalam sebuah eksperimen radikal bertajuk “THE CALL OF THE VOID.” Alih-alih sutra dan wol standar, Roseberry memahat siluet surealis dari genangan cat yang dipanggang, silikon, dan tentakel lateks kinetik. Tampilan standout menampilkan motif bunga yang dibentuk dari hosiery yang diregangkan, serta busana berkilau sisik ikan asli. Show ini juga menyedot perhatian lewat kehadiran tamu bertabur bintang, termasuk Bad Bunny yang tampil dalam setelan Schiaparelli Haute Couture kustom.Dongeng atau Petualangan Sehari-hari? Koleksi Chanel "Gaby and the Beanstalk" Menulis Ulang Haute CoutureUntuk show Haute Couture keduanya, Matthieu Blazy di Chanel menghadirkan "Gaby and the Beanstalk," perpaduan tailoring klasik rumah mode tersebut dengan folklore yang jenaka dan imajinatif. Koleksi FW26 ini membelokkan tema sastra klasik menjadi busana yang fungsional dan mudah bergerak. Blazy membuka show dengan setelan bespoke dari renda guipure kustom yang dirancang menyerupai magic beans. Motif naratif lain menjalar ke seluruh lini, muncul sebagai sulur tanaman yang merambat di sepatu, minaudière berbentuk beruang tertidur, dan kancing yang berubah dari anak bebek menjadi angsa. Di balik eksterior yang fantasi, setiap tampilan diperkaya detail kain yang disayat dan kantong interior tersembunyi, menciptakan keseimbangan mulus antara dongeng haute couture dan kegunaan sehari-hari.Nike Atelier Menggandeng Désiré Doué dari Team France untuk Sneakers Edisi TerbatasBintang sepak bola Prancis dan pemain Piala Dunia Désiré Doué berkolaborasi dengan Nike Atelier untuk merilis sneakers lifestyle edisi terbatas dengan siluet yang sleek. Desain kolaboratif ini menjembatani performa di lapangan dan gaya harian, mengadopsi upper kulit hitam dari boots ikonis Nike Mercurial 1998. Di balik tampilan retro-football, tersembunyi midsole modern bergaya Pegasus yang dilengkapi bantalan Air berwarna biru terang yang terekspos. Lidah sepatu lipat dengan emboss halus bertuliskan “NIKE ATELIER” menyempurnakan estetika yang refined tersebut. Diposisikan sebagai selebrasi kultur atlet di luar lapangan, sneakers bernuansa stealth ini pertama kali dirilis lewat pre-order eksklusif di toko Dover Street Market Paris sebelum meluncur lebih luas musim panas ini. id.title: Nike dan NIGO Gandeng Design Museum London Luncurkan Koleksi Apparel "From Japan with Love"
id.description: Ringkasan Nike berkolaborasi dengan NIGO dan Design Museum London untuk meluncurkan kapsul apparel eksklusif.Koleksi ini hadir untuk mengiringi pameran retrospektif besar sang desainer di Inggris yang berlangsung hingga musim gugur.Beberapa item pilihan seperti jaket coaches dan T-shirt grafis akan dirilis bertahap dalam beberapa gelombang sepanjang musim panas. Nike dan NIGO melanjutkan kolaborasi mereka dengan Design Museum di London untuk memperkenalkan koleksi apparel Nike x NIGO "From Japan with Love". Dirilis bertepatan dengan pameran retrospektif besar sang kreator multidisipliner, koleksi kapsul kolaboratif ini menerjemahkan warisan desain Ura-Harajuku selama berdekade-dekade ke dalam busana gaya hidup modern.Rangkaian kolaboratif ini berfokus pada item streetwear esensial berkualitas premium yang terinspirasi langsung dari arsip desain pribadi NIGO. Sorotan dari deretan apparel edisi terbatas ini adalah jaket coaches klasik dan T-shirt grafis serasi, yang keduanya mengangkat detail desain dari karya-karya yang pertama kali diciptakan pada tahun 1993. Setiap potongannya menampilkan branding khas yang memadukan Nike Swoosh ikonis dengan tipografi kustom, sebagai penghormatan pada estetika visual butik legendaris NOWHERE.Dirancang untuk merayakan titik temu antara fashion, seni, dan komunitas, koleksi kapsul ini meluas hingga mencakup hoodie fleece co-branded dan aksesori harian seperti beanie. Setiap item menjadi perpanjangan organik dari tata pameran di museum, menjembatani referensi Americana vintage dengan kenyamanan sportswear kontemporer. Alih-alih dirilis sekaligus, koleksi ini akan hadir dalam beberapa fase berurutan untuk menjaga kehadiran yang konsisten sepanjang masa pameran. Pameran "NIGO: From Japan with Love" di Design Museum berlangsung hingga 4 Oktober.Koleksi apparel Nike x NIGO sudah tersedia di Design Museum Shop dan online. Drake International Mourns the Passing of Founder Bill Pollock
bd.description: The Winnipeg-born entrepreneur who pioneered an industry, championed opportunity and spent 75 years making the world a better place TORONTO , July 10, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Bill Pollock, founder of Drake International, passed away July 7, 2026 in Monaco at the age of 97. A humble and private person, Bill's insatiable curiosity and global mindset was a recipe for success. Over 75 years, he co-founded an industry, created tens of millions of jobs, championed women in the workforce from the very beginning, and built a global enterprise now operating in 14 countries with partner relationships across 128 more — all starting with a conviction that meaningful work changes lives. William “Bill” Pollock Born in Winnipeg, Manitoba in 1928, the youngest of nine children of Austrian and Polish immigrants, Bill embodied the belief that opportunity, when given, multiplies. A scholarship to the University of Manitoba changed the course of his life. Decades later, he established the Drake Centre at the Asper School of Business to ensure countless others would be given that same chance. Through Drake International, he created jobs, expanded industries and generated economic progress across generations. He didn't only build a company — he built for what comes next. A Pioneer in Industry, Technology and Inclusion Together with Drake International co-founder Jim Shore, Bill identified a gap in how businesses managed fluctuating workloads and launched Office Overload in Winnipeg — pioneering what would become the modern staffing industry. Drake International was born from that insight in 1951 and has since grown into a worldwide provider of staffing and recruitment, certification and assessment, health and wellbeing, and business-process outsourcing services. Long before "digital transformation" entered everyday business language, Bill was investing in technologies that connected people across borders, among them PictureTalk, a pre-Zoom video platform, and The Coordinator, one of the first global business email systems. In the 1960s, he personally delivered a speech to Pope Paul VI introducing the theme "One Planet, One People, One Purpose," a belief that guided him throughout his life. As an early member of the Young Presidents' Organization, he helped expand its reach from North America to Europe, the United Kingdom, Australia, Asia and beyond. And decades before diversity became a business imperative, Bill actively championed women for leadership roles. Today, nearly 80 per cent of Drake International's global leadership team is comprised of women — a lasting reflection of his conviction that leadership should always be earned through talent, character and capability. Quotes "Bill saw potential in people before they saw it in themselves — and then he devoted himself to making sure they had every reason to prove him right. He led with high expectations and lifted people to achieve outcomes they didn't even know were possible. I feel privileged and grateful to have spent 33 years being influenced, taught and led by him." — Karen Meredith, Global CEO and Trustee, Drake International "He built Drake International to outlast any one person — including himself. It was the plan, pursued with the same clarity and discipline he brought to everything he created. The strength of this organization today is Bill's greatest achievement." — Glenn Agro, Chair, Drake International Board of Trustees A Thoughtful Succession In July 2024, Bill transitioned to the role of Chairman Emeritus, with Karen Meredith assuming leadership of Drake International reporting to an independent Board of Trustees. In 2023, he wrote personally to all Drake International employees reaffirming his commitment to their future, on his own terms, in his own time: "I am working with my team to advance my legacy while ensuring your and Drake International's well-being and continued success for years to come." When asked how he wished to be remembered, his answer was simple: "For making it a better world." His friends, colleagues and the tens of millions of lives touched through Drake International remain his enduring legacy. About Drake International Drake International is a global talent management and workforce advisory partner with operations in 14 countries with a partner network spanning 128 more. Founded in Winnipeg in 1951, Drake supports organizations across the full talent lifecycle through Workforce Solutions (flexible staffing, permanent recruitment, on-site services), Certification, Assessment and Training, Health and Wellbeing, HR Advisory, and Drake Ventures. www.drakeinternational.com Media Contacts: Louanne Buckley, louanne.buckley@drakeintl.com and Elizabeth Ortega, eco@ecostrats.com

sa.title: ورش تدريبية وجولات تناظرية.. جدة التاريخية تستضيف مبادرات ثقافية
sa.description:
تعزز جدة التاريخية حضورها بوصفها وجهة ثقافية رائدة، من خلال إعادة توظيف مبانيها التاريخية لاحتضان البرامج الثقافية والمبادرات النوعية.

وتُسهم تلك الإجراءات في إحياء النسيج العمراني، ويمنح المواقع التراثية أدوارًا جديدة تجمع بين المحافظة على قيمتها التاريخية وتعزيز استدامتها.

المبادرات الثقافية في جدة التاريخية

ويقدم بيت الشربتلي الثقافي، بالتعاون مع "وصل" والمركز السعودي للفلسفة والأخلاقيات، "معسكر المناظرات 2026"، امتدادًا لهذا التوجه.

ويجسد توظيف المباني التاريخية في استضافة برامج معرفية تُسهم في تنمية مهارات التفكير النقدي، وبناء الحجج وصياغتها، وإدارة الحوار، ضمن بيئة تدريبية وتطبيقية متخصصة.

ويشتمل المعسكر، الذي يقام خلال الفترة من 15 يوليو إلى 12 أغسطس 2026، بواقع يومين في الأسبوع، على ورش عمل تدريبية، وجولات تناظرية، ولقاءات حوارية تُنظَّم ضمن بيئة تنافسية تحاكي البطولات الدولية، بإشراف نخبة من المختصين، بما يتيح للمشاركين اكتساب المهارات اللازمة في بناء الحجج وصياغتها، وتفنيدها، وإدارة الاختلاف بوعي ومسؤولية.

استثمار المباني التراثية

وتعكس هذه المبادرات توجه جدة التاريخية نحو توسيع حضورها الثقافي عبر استثمار المباني التراثية في احتضان الفعاليات والورش والبرامج المتخصصة، بما يعزز الحركة الثقافية داخل المنطقة التاريخية، ويستقطب المبدعين والمهتمين، ويفعّل دور هذه المواقع بوصفها فضاءات للإبداع والتعلم والتفاعل المجتمعي.

وأسهمت المبادرات الثقافية المتنوعة في إعادة تنشيط عدد من المباني التاريخية، إلى جانب توفير بيئات داعمة للحرفيين والمبدعين، وتنظيم فعاليات تثري المشهد الثقافي، بما يعزز ارتباط المجتمع بالمكان، ويدعم استمرارية الموروث الثقافي.

ويؤكد هذا النهج أن المحافظة على المباني التاريخية لا تقتصر على أعمال الترميم، بل تمتد إلى إعادة توظيفها ثقافيًا ومعرفيًا، بما يحافظ على هويتها، ويجعلها جزءًا فاعلًا من الحياة اليومية، ويعزز مكانة جدة التاريخية وجهةً ثقافيةً مستدامة.

ml.title: PMU-Mali: Programme officiel du dimanche 12 juillet 2026
Aigles du Mali : Anthony Da Silva fixe le cap
ml.description: © Internet Un mois après la signature officielle de son contrat, Anthony Da Silva a effectué sa première sortie devant la presse le 6 juillet 2026 à Bamako. Le nouveau sélectionneur des Aigles a dessiné les contours d’un projet fondé sur l’exigence, l’identité et le jeu. La ligne directrice est fixée. Anthony Da Silva veut bâtir une sélection compétitive, ouverte, mais encadrée par des principes clairs. Son ambition est d’installer une méthode, une discipline et une culture de la performance. « Je vais tout faire et tout donner pour rendre le sourire au peuple malien. Cela ne sera pas facile, nous allons y aller étape par étape », a-t-il déclaré dans une prise de parole à la fois prudente et ambitieuse. Pour y parvenir, le sélectionneur entend clarifier les règles d’accès à l’équipe nationale. Les critères sont établis : « le patriotisme, qui est non négociable, la discipline, non négociable aussi, les performances et l’état d’esprit ». Une sélection ouverte, mais exigeante Anthony Da Silva assure que la porte restera ouverte à tous les profils, sans distinction entre joueurs locaux et expatriés. « À partir du moment où les joueurs rentrent dans les critères que nous avons définis, qu’ils évoluent dans le championnat local ou à l’étranger, qu’ils aient 17 ans ou 35 ans, ils pourront être appelés », a-t-il insisté. Sur le terrain, le nouveau patron des Aigles veut une équipe plus entreprenante. Son idée est claire : prendre l’initiative, garder le ballon et imposer le rythme. « J’aime que mes équipes soient protagonistes du jeu, qu’elles aient le ballon, parce que c’est nous qui devons dicter le rythme ». Dans les trente derniers mètres, Da Silva veut une équipe « plus tueuse », convaincu que ce détail a manqué au Mali ces dernières années. La CAN 2027 comme premier test Ce projet devra vite se traduire en résultats. Dès septembre prochain, les éliminatoires de la CAN 2027 offriront au nouveau sélectionneur son premier grand défi. Le Mali évoluera dans un groupe comprenant le Cap-Vert, auteur d’une Coupe du monde solide en restant invaincu dans le temps réglementaire face à l’Espagne, l’Uruguay et l’Argentine, ainsi que le Liberia et le Rwanda. Pour réussir cette entrée en matière, Anthony Da Silva mise aussi sur un travail quotidien avec la Fédération et la Direction technique nationale. « C’est un travail collectif », a-t-il rappelé, avant de résumer son engagement en trois mots : « honnêteté, transparence et beaucoup de travail ». Mohamed Kenouvi

ml.title: Culture : « TƐGƐNƆ », l’empreinte d’un héritage ancestral
ml.description: © Internet Au Musée national du Mali, l’artiste Abdou Ouologuem propose « TƐGƐNƆ », « L’Empreinte », une exposition qui met en dialogue les collections patrimoniales du musée et la création contemporaine. À travers objets anciens, œuvres d’art, photographies et traces matérielles du passé, elle interroge la transmission de l’héritage malien aux jeunes générations. Dans la salle d’exposition, le bruit de la ville s’efface. Sous une lumière douce, les visiteurs avancent entre les vitrines, face à des pièces qui racontent plusieurs siècles d’histoire. Bijoux, statuettes, manuscrits, instruments de musique et objets du quotidien rappellent la richesse des savoir-faire, des croyances et des modes de vie qui ont façonné le Mali. Le parcours réserve aussi des découvertes plus rares. Des fragments de textiles anciens, issus des grottes des Tellem en pays dogon, témoignent d’une maîtrise ancienne du tissage. « J’ai appris ici que nos ancêtres pouvaient transformer la laine de mouton en tissu bien avant l’arrivée des techniques modernes », confie Kadidiatou Sow, étudiante en patrimoine culturel. À quelques pas de là, les parures en or, en argent et en cuir, ainsi que le « Tafé », habit traditionnel lié à l’honneur et à la protection de la femme, rappellent que le vêtement pouvait aussi porter une dignité sociale. Mémoire visuelle La force de « TƐGƐNƆ » tient à son refus d’enfermer le patrimoine dans le passé. Les œuvres contemporaines, notamment celles d’Abdoulaye Konaté, répondent aux poteries, aux masques et aux objets anciens. Les photographies de Malick Sidibé et de Seydou Keïta, témoins de l’élégance et des mutations sociales du Mali moderne, dialoguent avec des manuscrits et des pièces rituelles. Pour Abdou Ouologuem, sortir ces objets des réserves du Musée national relève d’un geste de transmission. « Je ne voulais pas parler d’une communauté plutôt que d’une autre. Je voulais parler de l’empreinte d’un peuple, de ce que nos ancêtres ont fait comme travail, de ce qu’ils nous ont laissé comme héritage », explique l’artiste. Le message touche les visiteurs. Pour Kadidiatou, le patrimoine malien n’a pas disparu, mais sa transmission s’est affaiblie. Elle estime qu’il faut l’enseigner dès l’enfance, à l’école comme dans les familles. En quittant l’exposition, les objets du quotidien prennent une autre valeur. Une calebasse, un tissu, un outil ou un geste artisanal deviennent les signes d’une mémoire encore vivante. « TƐGƐNƆ » rappelle ainsi qu’un peuple ne construit son avenir qu’en reconnaissant l’empreinte de ceux qui l’ont précédé. Salimata Wagué

zm.title: The GTA 3 Mission That Reinvented It All - Art of the Level
zm.description: Few missions in GTA’s history would make such a big and noticeable change to the geography of the host city as the GTA 3 mission, Bomb Da Base Act II, which goes some way to explaining why all 45 seconds of this short, sharp, Tin Can Alley sniper mission remains so memorable.Bomb Da Base in GTA 3 massively raises expectations for what’s to come, and proved to be a tantalising glimpse at the ever more complex, Bruckheimer-worthy setpieces that would come to define Rockstar’s later games, their narratives, and the subversive mission design that this most Triple-A of Triple-A studios is capable of.By today’s standards, it’s extraordinarily simple. But make no mistake: with GTA 3, Rockstar invented the modern video game, and with Bomb da Base Act II, GTA reinvented itself.

cm.title: Climat et santé : l’ONACC mise sur les créateurs de contenu
cm.description: © DR Présent à la 5e édition du Sommet des Blogueurs du Cameroun, l'Observatoire national sur les changements climatiques a plaidé pour une meilleure diffusion des données climatologiques afin de renforcer la prévention sanitaire et l'information des populations. Les changements climatiques s'imposent désormais comme un enjeu majeur de santé publique. C'est le message porté par l'Observatoire national sur les changements climatiques (ONACC) lors de la 5e édition du Sommet des Blogueurs du Cameroun, organisée le 7 juillet 2026 à l'Institut français de Yaoundé autour du thème : « Blogging et Santé : situation, promotion et opportunités au Cameroun ». Représentant l'ONACC, le Dr Kimming Ignatius Ngala a insisté sur les interactions entre les phénomènes climatiques et la recrudescence de maladies telles que le paludisme ou le choléra. Il a souligné la nécessité d'intégrer les données climatologiques dans les politiques de santé publique afin d'améliorer la prévention et la gestion des risques sanitaires. Face aux créateurs de contenus, le responsable a également rappelé leur rôle stratégique dans la sensibilisation des citoyens. Il les a invités à vulgariser les résultats des études produites par l'ONACC et à relayer les alertes climatiques afin de favoriser une meilleure anticipation communautaire et de limiter la propagation de fausses informations. Au terme des échanges, blogueurs, experts en santé humaine, animale et environnementale ont recommandé de faire des créateurs de contenus des partenaires de premier plan dans l'éducation, la prévention et la promotion d'une information sanitaire fiable. Un engagement jugé essentiel pour renforcer le lien entre les politiques publiques et les populations, tout en luttant contre la désinformation sur les plateformes numériques. Cet article Climat et santé : l’ONACC mise sur les créateurs de contenu est apparu en premier sur Journalducameroun.com .
